हद् हद्, cl. 1. A. हदते, जहदे, हत्स्यते,
अहत्त, हत्तुम्, to evacuate, excrete or dis-
charge excrement: Caus. हादयति: Desid. जिहत्-
सते: Intens. जाहद्यते, जाहत्ति; [cf. Zend zad;
[]
Gr. χέζ-ω (κέ-χοδ-α, χε-σοῦ-μαι), χεσείω, χόδ-ο-ς,
χόδ-ανο-ς; Angl. Sax. scît-e; Old Germ. scîz-u.]

हदन, अम्, n. the act of excretion, evacuation
(of excrement or ordure).

हद्दा हद्दा, f., (in astronomy) N. of a di-
vision of each zodiacal sign, (thirty such divisions are
specified and distributed variously to each planet;
according to some, a masc. form of this word exists.)
—हद्देश (˚दा-ईश), अस्, m. ‘lord of a thirtieth
division of a zodiacal sign,’ (probably) an epithet of
the planets (= त्रिंशांश-प).
